channel.title: Wings blog
channel.description: Essays on why Wings exists, BYOK AI, data safety, and keyboard-first notes.

item.title: Why Wings exists
item.description: I hit a Notion workspace limit in February 2026 and built a notes app for myself. Friends used it. It grew into Wings.

item.title: BYOK AI in the browser
item.description: Wings runs its AI panel with your own provider keys in the browser. Keys stay local. Prompts go to the model you choose.

item.title: How Wings refuses to lose your notes
item.description: Empty saves, empty drafts, and empty collab replays are blocked when they would wipe real content.

item.title: Keyboard-first notes in Wings
item.description: Slash commands, nested pages, AI panel, and export without leaving the keyboard.
